description: Get comprehensive table profile: row count, column types, distinct values, sample data. Auto-detects dimension/reference tables (dim_, ref_, lookup_ prefix). Ideal for understanding lookup tables before writing queries.

sample_rows.description: Number of sample rows to display (default: 3)

show_distinct_values.description: Show distinct values for each column (auto-enabled for dim/ref tables)

table_name.description: Table name (with or without schema prefix)

name: db_table_profile
title: Profile Table
